About your forecast

Harbour is a New Zealand boating and fishing forecast baseline. Weather values are model forecasts.

Weather and marine data: Open-Meteo. Marine models include ECMWF, NOAA NCEP, DWD and Météo-France, using Copernicus Marine Service information. Data licences · Marine methodology.

Marine values use the nearest available sea model cell.

Wave height means significant wave height. Individual waves can be larger. Model currents are coarse offshore estimates, not tidal stream predictions for channels or bars.

All forecast times use New Zealand local time. Data is fetched when you open a spot or refresh. After six hours, saved forecasts are marked stale. Offline forecasts always show when they were downloaded.

Tides use published LINZ port predictions for 2026–2027 (CC BY 4.0). Heights are above the port chart datum; weather can change actual water levels. These downloads are not official tide tables for statutory navigation. Marine warnings remain linked to MetService.

Forecasts, preferences and marks stay on this device. Forecast/search coordinates go to Open-Meteo. Chart imagery comes from LINZ via a public ArcGIS archive; coast tiles come from OpenStreetMap and OpenSeaMap. An optional LDS connection sends chart requests directly to LINZ. Marks and your LDS key are not sent to this site’s host.

The map includes LINZ NZ 53 (Hauraki Gulf) depth soundings, contours and symbols under CC BY 4.0. Its source was updated 13 January 2022 and exported 18 April 2023. This is a dated reference chart, not a current navigational ENC. Wider LINZ sheet access needs your own LDS key. The same map code runs in the Android app.
